--- positional
on a()
    return 0
end a

on b(x)
    return x
end b

on c(x, y, z)
    return x + y + z
end c

on t()
    return a() + b(1) + c(1, 2, 3) + b(b(b(1))) + c(a(), b(1), c(1, 2, 3))
end t
--- call forms
on a(x)
    return x
end a

on t()
    set r to a(1)
    a(2)
    my a(3)
    my a(4)
    tell me
        a(5)
    end tell
    return {r, a(6), my a(7), a(8) & "s"}
end t
--- labeled prepositions
on moveIt from a to b
    return {a, b}
end moveIt

on findIt of x above y below z
    return {x, y, z}
end findIt

on t()
    return {(moveIt from 1 to 2), (findIt of 1 above 2 below 3), (moveIt from 1 to 2) & 3}
end t
--- labeled given
on check of x given strict:s, limit:l
    return {x, s, l}
end check

on t()
    set a to check of 1 with strict given limit:2
    set b to check of 1 with strict given limit:2
    set c to check of 1 without strict given limit:2
    return {a, b, c, (check of 1 without strict given limit:3) & 1}
end t
--- labeled all prepositions
on p about a above b against c apart from d around e aside from f at g below h beneath i beside j between k by l for m from n instead of o into q on r onto s out of u over v since w thru x under y
    return {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l, m, n, o, q, r, s, u, v, w, x, y}
end p
--- direct only
on shout of x given loud:b
    return x
end shout

on whisper to x
    return x
end whisper

on t()
    return {(shout of 1 to 2 with loud and whisper)}
end t
--- patterns in parameters
on a({x, y})
    return x + y
end a

on b({x, {y, z}}, w)
    return x + y + z + w
end b

on c({name:n, id:i})
    return {n, i}
end c

on t()
    return {a({1, 2}), b({1, {2, 3}}, 4), c({name:"n", id:1})}
end t
--- recursion
on fact(n)
    if n ≤ 1 then
        return 1
    end if
    return n * (fact(n - 1))
end fact
--- handler returning list and using result
on pair(x)
    return {x, x + 1}
end pair

on t()
    set {a, b} to pair(1)
    pair(2)
    set c to item 1 of result
    return a + b + c + (item 2 of pair(3))
end t
--- locals and globals
property p1 : 0

on t(x)
    global g1, g2
    set a to x
    set b to a
    set g1 to b
    set g2 to g1
    set p1 to g2
    set p1 of me to 1
    return {a, b, g1, g2, p1, p1 of me}
end t
--- properties
property a : 1
property b : "two"
property c : {1, 2, 3}
property d : {x:1, y:2}
property e : missing value
property f : true
property g : 1.5
property h : {}
property i : 1
property j : 3.141592653589793
property k : "ab"
property l : 3

on t()
    return {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l}
end t
--- property and global with same uses
property counter : 0

on bump()
    set counter to counter + 1
    return counter
end bump

on reset()
    set counter of me to 0
end reset
--- handler variables shadowing
property x : 1

on t(x)
    return x
end t

on u()
    local x
    set x to 2
    return x
end u

on v()
    return x
end v
--- first class handlers
on a(x)
    return x + 1
end a

on applyIt(f, x)
    script holder
        property g : f
    end script
    return holder's g(x)
end applyIt

on t()
    return applyIt(a, 1)
end t
--- event handlers
on open theFiles
    return theFiles
end open

on idle
    return 60
end idle

on quit
    continue quit
end quit

on reopen
    return
end reopen
--- run handler forms
on run {a, b}
    return a + b
end run
--- handlers calling with complex args
on a(x, y)
    return x
end a

on t(l)
    return a(item 1 of l, {1, 2}) + a(length of l, l) + a(a(1, 2), a(3, 4)) + a({k:1}, "s" & l) + a(-1, not true) + a(l as text, length of l)
end t
--- handler names
on doIt()
end doIt

on do_it()
end do_it

on |do it|()
end |do it|

on doIt2(x)
end doIt2

on t()
    doIt()
    do_it()
    |do it|()
    doIt2(1)
end t
--- return handler result of tell
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        return my helper(name of startup disk)
    end tell
end t

on helper(x)
    return x
end helper
--- continue forms
script parentScript
    on greet(x)
        return "hello " & x
    end greet

    on shout given text:x
        return x
    end shout
end script

script child
    property parent : parentScript

    on greet(x)
        return (continue greet(x)) & "!"
    end greet

    on shout given text:x
        continue shout given text:(x & "!")
    end shout
end script
--- handler with try and labeled error
on t(x)
    try
        error "boom" number 7
    on error m number n
        return {m, n}
    end try
end t
--- many parameters and locals
on t(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l, m, n, o, p)
    set q to a + b + c + d + e + f + g + h
    set r to i + j + k + l + m + n + o + p
    set s to q + r
    set u to s * 2
    set v to u - q
    set w to v - r
    return {q, r, s, u, v, w}
end t
--- script objects
script counter
    property n : 0

    on bump()
        set n to n + 1
        return n
    end bump

    on reset()
        set n to 0
    end reset
end script

on t()
    counter's bump()
    tell counter
        bump()
    end tell
    tell counter
        bump()
        set its n to 5
        set m to its n
        reset()
    end tell
    return {n of counter, n of counter, m}
end t
--- script object in handler
on makeCounter(start)
    script c
        property n : start

        on bump()
            set n to n + 1
        end bump
    end script
    return c
end makeCounter

on t()
    set a to makeCounter(1)
    set b to makeCounter(10)
    a's bump()
    tell b
        bump()
    end tell
    return {n of a, n of b}
end t
--- script inheritance
script base
    property kind : "base"

    on describe()
        return "I am " & kind
    end describe

    on helper()
        return 1
    end helper
end script

script derived
    property parent : base
    property kind : "derived"

    on describe()
        return (continue describe()) & "!"
    end describe

    on both()
        return {kind of me, kind of parent, helper(), my helper()}
    end both
end script

on t()
    return {derived's describe(), derived's both(), base's describe()}
end t
--- nested script objects
script outer
    property a : 1

    script midLevel
        property b : 2

        script inner
            property c : 3

            on sum()
                return c
            end sum
        end script

        on sum()
            return b + (inner's sum())
        end sum
    end script

    on sum()
        return a + (midLevel's sum())
    end sum
end script
--- script with run handler
script job
    property done : false

    on run
        set done to true
        return 1
    end run
end script

on t()
    run job
    tell job
        run
    end tell
    return done of job
end t
--- script with parent application
script finderHelper
    property parent : application "Finder"

    on diskName()
        return name of startup disk
    end diskName
end script
--- script object properties referencing
script config
    property items_ : {1, 2, 3}
    property title : "t"
    property nested : {a:1, b:{c:2}}
end script

on t()
    set end of items_ of config to 4
    set title of config to "u"
    set c of b of nested of config to 3
    return {items_ of config, title of config, c of b of nested of config, item 1 of items_ of config, length of items_ of config}
end t
--- anonymous script
on t()
    script
        property x : 1
    end script
    return x of result
end t
--- script copied
script proto
    property n : 0
end script

on t()
    copy proto to a
    set b to proto
    set n of a to 1
    return {n of a, n of b, n of proto}
end t
--- load and run script commands
on t(f)
    set lib to load script f
    set r to run script f
    set s to run script "1 + 1"
    set u to run script f with parameters {1, 2}
    store script lib in f replacing yes
    return {lib, r, s, u}
end t
--- handler in tell target context
on t(x)
    tell x
        set a to my helper(it)
        set b to my helper(1)
    end tell
    return {a, b}
end t

on helper(y)
    return y
end helper
--- global used at top level
on bump()
    global total
    set total to total + 1
end bump

set total to 0
bump()
bump()
return total
